title: North Carolina Executive Mansion
geometryBasis: WakeGIS-derived 35-vertex mapped mansion footprint, two exact CC0 Qualla originals from October 2025, and the state architectural account.
sectionBasis: Queen Anne brick mansion with three front gables, twin upper cedar loggias, slate bands, a central sloped porch and light marble stair, and outward-running timber verandas.
limitations: This exterior represents the permanent architecture visible in October 2025. Seasonal decorations, street furnishings and interior spaces are outside the model.
The two east-facing photographs guide the west elevation. Roof heights and joins, east-facing windows and side roof forms are approximate.
The massing follows the mapped mansion and verandas. The sampled terrain is retained and individual steps and grades remain approximate.
